The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time – Review

Overall Rating: 9.5/10

One of the greatest strengths of Ocarina of Time is its ability to make every region feel like a different world, with its own atmosphere, challenges, enemies, and secrets.

1. Beautiful and Diverse Environments

One of the game's most impressive features is the variety of environments:

- Kokiri Forest: A beautiful, peaceful forest filled with greenery and mystery.
- Death Mountain: A dangerous volcanic region with lava, fire, and challenging enemies.
- Zora's Domain: A stunning aquatic environment with waterfalls, rivers, and underwater exploration.
- Gerudo Desert: A vast desert with a completely different atmosphere and environmental challenges.
- Temples and Dungeons: Each has its own visual identity, atmosphere, puzzles, and unique challenges.

The environments make exploration feel like travelling through several different worlds rather than simply moving across one map.

2. Different Ways to Fight Bosses

Boss battles are one of the most enjoyable aspects of Ocarina of Time.

Rather than relying on the same attack strategy for every boss, the game encourages players to understand each enemy's mechanics.

- Exploiting weaknesses: Identify vulnerable body parts and attack at the right moment.
- Using different weapons: Bows, bombs, Hookshot, and other equipment play important roles.
- Timing and precision: Some bosses require careful observation, dodging, and attacking during specific openings.
- Environmental interaction: Certain battles involve using the arena and its mechanics to gain an advantage.
- Different combat challenges: Every major boss introduces a different pattern and requires a different approach.

This makes boss encounters feel like individual challenges rather than repetitive fights.

3. Overall Experience

Ocarina of Time delivers an outstanding adventure through:

- Beautiful and diverse environments.
- Memorable dungeons and puzzles.
- Creative and challenging boss battles.
- A memorable fantasy atmosphere.
- Exploration that constantly rewards curiosity.

Final Verdict

Final Rating: 10/10

Ocarina of Time demonstrates why great adventure games need more than impressive graphics. The diversity of its environments and the creativity of its boss battles make the journey truly memorable.

Restrictions on Player FreedomSome NPCs cannot be killed, even when the player shoots them.Certain characters appear to have scripted protection.This limits player freedom, which has always been one of the defining features of the GTA **** is disappointing to see a game built around freedom restricting certain player actions.
2. Glitches and Technical IssuesNPCs clipping through objects and environments.Characters falling through the map.Vehicle physics and collision glitches.Bugs during missions.Occasional crashes, freezes, and unexpected behavior.
3. Poor Performance and OptimizationThe game is limited to 30 FPS on consoles at **** 60 FPS Performance Mode, even on PS5 Pro.Frame drops during demanding scenes.Occasional stuttering and inconsistent performance.

GTA VI is visually impressive, but beautiful graphics alone do not make a perfect game. Player freedom, technical stability, and smooth performance are equally important.A GTA game should allow players to interact with the world freely, not arbitrarily restrict their actions. For a title with this much hype and development time, these shortcomings deserve criticism.
